units.source_text: 正是屋后面橘子园花开的时节，一天晚上，阿住坐在油灯下，一边干活，一边又有条不絮的说起招赘的事情。

en.t: It was the season when the orange trees behind the house were in bloom. One evening, Osumi sat under the oil lamp, working as she once again brought up the matter of taking in a husband for the family.

units.source_text: 阿民在炉子旁边盘坐，嘴里咬着咸豌豆，不敢苟同的说：“您为什么要又要提起招赘的事情呢？

en.t: Otami sat cross-legged beside the hearth, biting on salted peas, and said in dissent, "Why do you have to bring up taking in a husband again?
I do not want to hear a word of it."

units.source_text: 倘若是以前的阿住，听阿民这么抗拒的回答，大概就会就此作罢，不再继续说下去了。

en.t: If this had been the old Osumi, hearing Otami answer with such resistance would probably have made her give up then and there and stop talking about it.

units.source_text: 但是这次却一反往常，阿住不肯结束的继续说道：“话也不能说的这么决绝啊！

en.t: But this time, contrary to her usual way, Osumi refused to let the matter drop and went on, "You should not speak so absolutely!

units.source_text: 明天宫下的葬礼，正好轮到咱们家负责挖墓穴，这种时候，最好要有一个男人在嘛……”

en.t: For the funeral at Miyashita's tomorrow, it happens to be our household's turn to dig the grave, and at a time like that it is best to have a man around..."
